column3: ornament of the world of chowries
and situated in the lotus pericarp
and the two pits of water
grazing, they sported there in child's games
with a pair of beautiful shanks
and with arghya, worship and so on
and should worship and wait upon
with beautiful lotus-bud face, long arms and eyes
with beautiful lotus-bud face, long arms and eyes, with loving smiles, playful glances, sweet words
and they do not deserve to suffer
and he who runs within the unmanifest path
and to him the seeker of blessings
Ashtaka, Harita, Jaya, Kratu, Mada and others
and made the two stumble, undeserving of honours
and by brahmanas of his home
wishing to do something else for the Self, dear
wishing to do, who obtained a body from Aditi
from what is wished to do
wishing to do the secret of the gods
the Lord wishing to do for her
the two sported with women like elephants
then he placed a pyre on the mountain peak
for purifying impurity of the mind
of the mind, mind and senses
of one whose stories are wonderful
wonderful trees, gardens of gods, sweet-voiced birds
by banners and flag tips, lordly elephants, chariots and horses
with colourful banners, flags and gateways
whose stories are dear and wonderful
with wonderful garlands, fruits and leaves
with colourful garlands, fruits and leaves
endowed with power of consciousness and the unconscious
of the nature of conscious and unconscious
consisting of consciousness and the unconscious
in the form of the sky of consciousness
the sage thinking of the matter
should meditate on the One as non-different
by the thought of the thought
experienced as the flavour of pure consciousness
when he had long been away
was angry like a struck serpent
the rivers and oceans were agitated
Achyuta raised the chin of the Self-delighted
mango sprouts, peacock feathers, flower clusters, blue lotus and lotus
two in variegated dress with mango sprouts, peacock feathers, flower clusters, blue lotus, lotus garlands
mango, priyala, jackfruit, asana, kovidara, rose-apple, calotropis, bilva, bakula, mango, kadamba, nipa
of powder, parched grain and flowers
the mind of the discus-bearer by chance
I depend by the mind alone
easily by mind, thought, action and speech
and if I am worshipped, directly
and if on the wrong path
and if he does not eat
the two wandered in the forest groves
to be stolen? (to be taken away)
and being the Self of the Lord
and in the superimposition of consciousness
and having addressed these said this
endowed with temple flags and banners
risen from the Chedi king's body
of the Chedi, Paundraka and Shalva
army of the lords of Chedi and Magadha
killing of the Chedi and so on
Chedi, Shalva, Jarasandha, Dantavakra and others
and him with minds attached, choked with tears
and among those equal to oneself
and stolen, even thus this one
and the two sons of Ahuka
and of those who go astray
and urged by the maya of the Lord
and sings near the songs of the Lord of great fame
in the form of four months
in theft, untruth, uselessness, violence and varied conduct
wishing to do, dear to solitary people
if the mind is like a bee
white parasol, moon, filaments, spray, water
with the head turned down at the top
the Kaustubha, priceless crown and earrings
gives welfare, the king of cures
gait impeded by the weight of hips
of the fallen from both worlds
by the time of six months
I shall bring away after snatching
made of Vedic metres, those greedy for austerity, knowledge and yoga
made of Vedic metres, made of nectar
having cut, experience of the Self of Achyuta remains
having cut doubt of the Self, should cease
having cut the fetter of affection for self
having cut with arrow, felled him
